A '''T-series tactical droid''' served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the Confederates and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Manufactured by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]]<ref name="Warfare" /> and standing 1.93 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="tcwce" /> the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was under the command of [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Piar Nagelsa/Legends|Piar Nagelsa]] prior to the [[First Battle of Plagen]]. Shortly before the battle, the droid [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] Nagelsa due to issues that most [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droids]] had with serving under unfit [[Species/Legends|organic]] leaders. The droid then assumed command over the Confederate forces as it threw away Nagelsa's battle plan and led the Confederate forces to win the battle.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The T-series tactical droid was first mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] on the conflicts in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
